mapper.select: SELECT id, parse_result_id AS parseResultId, report_id AS reportId, parse_version AS parseVersion, raw_name AS rawName, raw_value AS rawValue, raw_unit AS rawUnit, canonical_code AS canonicalCode, specimen_type AS specimenType, normalized_value AS normalizedValue, normalized_unit AS normalizedUnit, normalization_status AS normalizationStatus, ref_low AS refLow, ref_high AS refHigh, conf_ocr AS confOcr, conf_structure AS confStructure, conf_extraction AS confExtraction, conf_normalization AS confNormalization, conf_name AS confName, conf_value AS confValue, conf_unit AS confUnit, conf_ref_range AS confRefRange FROM report_indicator WHERE parse_result_id = #{parseResultId} ORDER BY id ASC
